```python
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

# ============================== TERM SYNTAX (spec-level) =====================
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Var:  name: str
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Zero: pass
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Add:  a: object; b: object
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Sub:  a: object; b: object
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Sum:  v: object
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Elem: a: object; b: object
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cons: h: object; t: object
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Nil:  pass

def ser(t):
    if isinstance(t, Var):   return t.name
    if isinstance(t, Zero):  return "zero"
    if isinstance(t, Nil):   return "nil"
    if isinstance(t, Add):   return "(add %s %s)"    % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Sub):   return "(sub %s %s)"    % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Sum):   return "(sum %s)"       % ser(t.v)
    if isinstance(t, Elem):  return "(eltsub %s %s)" % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Cons):  return "(cons %s %s)"   % (ser(t.h), ser(t.t))
    raise TypeError(t)

def E(l, r): return (l, r)                       # an obligation's goal = a term pair

# ============================== OBLIGATION SET ===============================
x, xs, y, ys = Var("x"), Var("xs"), Var("y"), Var("ys")
zero, nil    = Zero(), Nil()

SUM_xs, SUM_ys = Sum(xs), Sum(ys)
IH   = (Sum(Elem(xs, ys)), Sub(SUM_xs, SUM_ys))
CONS_L = Elem(Cons(x, xs), Cons(y, ys))
CONS_R = Cons(Sub(x, y), Elem(xs, ys))
SUMCL, SUMCR = Sum(CONS_L), Sum(CONS_R)

# n_prem = how many premises each rule form takes; only used for arity checking
N_PREM = {"refl":0,"def_elem_nil":0,"def_elem_cons":0,"def_sum_nil":0,
          "def_sum_cons":0,"def_sub":0,"ax_abgrp":0,"assume":0,
          "sym":1,"sum_cong":1,"add_cong":2,"sub_cong":2,"trans":2,"induct":2}

OBL = []          # (id, rule, goal, premises)
def obl(i, rule, l, r, frm=()): OBL.append((i, rule, E(l, r), list(frm)))

# ---------------- L1 : BASE CASE  sum(eltsub(nil,nil)) = sum(nil) - sum(nil) --
obl("B1","def_elem_nil",  Elem(nil,nil),      nil)
obl("B2","sum_cong",      Sum(Elem(nil,nil)), Sum(nil),                      ["B1"])
obl("B3","def_sum_nil",   Sum(nil),           zero)
obl("B4","trans",         Sum(Elem(nil,nil)), zero,                          ["B2","B3"])
obl("B5","def_sum_nil",   Sum(nil),           zero)
obl("B6","def_sum_nil",   Sum(nil),           zero)
obl("B7","sub_cong",      Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)), Sub(zero,zero),            ["B5","B6"])
obl("B8","ax_abgrp",      zero,               Sub(zero,zero))
obl("B9","sym",           Sub(zero,zero),     Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)),        ["B7"])
obl("B10","trans",        zero,               Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)),        ["B8","B9"])
obl("B11","trans",        Sum(Elem(nil,nil)), Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)),        ["B4","B10"])

# ---------------- L2 : LHS REDUCTION, step case ------------------------------
obl("S1","def_elem_cons", CONS_L,             CONS_R,                        [])
obl("S2","sum_cong",      SUMCL,              SUMCR,                         ["S1"])
obl("S3","def_sum_cons",  SUMCR,              Add(Sub(x,y), Sum(Elem(xs,ys))))
obl("S4","trans",         SUMCL,              Add(Sub(x,y), Sum(Elem(xs,ys))),["S2","S3"])
obl("S5","refl",          Sub(x,y),           Sub(x,y))
obl("S6","assume",        IH[0],              IH[1])                          # hypothesis

# ---------------- L3 : USE THE INDUCTION HYPOTHESIS --------------------------
obl("S7","add_cong",      Add(Sub(x,y), Sum(Elem(xs,ys))),
                          Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs, SUM_ys)),                 ["S5","S6"])
obl("S8","trans",         SUMCL,              Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),["S4","S7"])

# ---------------- L4 : RHS REDUCTION ----------------------------------------
obl("S9","def_sum_cons",  Sum(Cons(x,xs)),    Add(x, SUM_xs))
obl("S10","def_sum_cons", Sum(Cons(y,ys)),    Add(y, SUM_ys))
obl("S11","sub_cong",     Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),
                          Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)),                  ["S9","S10"])

# ---------------- L5 : THE ALGEBRAIC LEAF -----------------------------------
obl("S12","ax_abgrp",     Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),
                          Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)))
obl("S13","sym",          Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)),
                          Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),              ["S11"])
obl("S14","trans",        Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),
                          Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),              ["S12","S13"])
obl("S15","trans",        SUMCL, Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),       ["S8","S14"])

# ---------------- L6 : INDUCTION DISCHARGE ----------------------------------
obl("F1","induct",        SUMCL, Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),       ["B11","S15"])

# ============================== SIDE CONDITIONS ==============================
SIDE = []
def side(i, desc, of): SIDE.append((i, desc, of))

for (i, rule, goal, frm) in OBL:
    if rule == "trans":
        p, q = dict((o[0],o) for o in OBL)[frm[0]], dict((o[0],o) for o in OBL)[frm[1]]
        side("sc_"+i, "middle term must match: %s == %s" % (ser(p[2][1]), ser(q[2][0])), i)
    elif rule == "ax_abgrp":
        side("sc_"+i, "normal forms must coincide (free abelian group, atoms = x,y,sum) ", i)
    elif rule == "refl":
        side("sc_"+i, "both sides must be the identical term", i)
    elif rule == "assume":
        side("sc_"+i, "context gains exactly: %s === %s" % (ser(goal[0]), ser(goal[1])), i)
    elif rule in ("def_elem_nil","def_elem_cons","def_sum_nil","def_sum_cons","def_sub"):
        side("sc_"+i, "goal must be the instance of `%s` named by its parameters" % rule, i)
    elif rule in ("sum_cong","add_cong","sub_cong","sym"):
        side("sc_"+i, "goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise", i)
    elif rule == "induct":
        side("sc_"+i+"a", "premise B11 must carry empty context", i)
        side("sc_"+i+"b", "premise S15 context must be EXACTLY { IH }", i)
        side("sc_"+i+"c", "base shape = (eltsub nil nil) / (sum nil - sum nil)", i)
        side("sc_"+i+"d", "step shape = (eltsub cons cons) / (sum cons - sum cons)", i)

# ============================== META OBLIGATIONS =============================
META = [
 ("M1","typing","`eltsub` is defined only on pairs in the SAME vector(R); totality on equal lengths is a typing fact, not a kernel goal"),
 ("M2","typing","`cons` preserves the carrier: R x vector(R) -> vector(R), so shared length is preserved"),
 ("M3","typing","the goal's premise `len(a) = len(b)` is absorbed by both a,b : vector(R) of the same n"),
 ("M4","modeling","rows lacking a real in either column are excluded when n is chosen; not a kernel goal"),
 ("M5","alternative","FOR UNTYPED LISTS the length premise is NOT absorbed; add goals: len(eltsub(a,b)) = len(a); len(cons(x,xs)) = 1 + len(xs); len(nil) = 0"),
]

# ============================== OPTIONAL REFINEMENT ==========================
# Eliminates the ax_abgrp oracle for S12 by spending def_sub + the four group axioms.
# R2 is the only non-trivial member: -(u+v) = (-u) + (-v).
U, V = Var("u"), Var("v")
OBL_R = [
 ("R1","def_sub",
   E(Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)),
     Add(Add(x,SUM_xs), Sub(zero, Add(y,SUM_ys))))),
 ("R2","ax_abgrp",                                  # the neg-distributivity lemma, as one goal
   E(Sub(zero, Add(y,SUM_ys)), Add(Sub(zero,y), Sub(zero,SUM_ys)))),
 ("R3","def_sub", E(Sub(x,y), Add(x, Sub(zero,y)))),
 ("R4","def_sub", E(Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys), Add(SUM_xs, Sub(zero,SUM_ys)))),
 ("R5","ax_abgrp",
   E(Add(Add(x,Sub(zero,y)), Add(SUM_xs,Sub(zero,SUM_ys))),
     Add(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(Sub(zero,y), Sub(zero,SUM_ys))))),
 ("R6","trans", E(Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),
                  Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys))))        # == goal of S12
]

# ============================== CONTEXT DISCIPLINE ===========================
IH_S = "%s === %s" % (ser(IH[0]), ser(IH[1]))
CTX = {}; DISCH = {}; order = {}
for i, rule, goal, frm in OBL:
    u = set().union(*[CTX[f] for f in frm]) if frm else set()
    d = {IH_S} if rule == "induct" else set()
    CTX[i] = u - d; DISCH[i] = d; order[i] = rule

# ============================== EMIT THE FILE ================================
L = ["muk/obligations@0.1",
     "# declaration: sum_of_elementwise_differences",
     "# syntax: obl <id> |- <lhs> === <rhs> :: <rule> from=[...] ctx=[...]",
     "# NOTHING HERE IS DISCHARGED. This file states WHAT must be proved.",
     ""]
for i, rule, goal, frm in OBL:
    L.append("obl %-4s |- %s === %s\n        :: %s from=[%s] ctx=[%s]"
             % (i, ser(goal[0]), ser(goal[1]), rule, ",".join(frm),
                ",".join(sorted(CTX[i])))) 
L.append("")
for i, desc, of in SIDE:
    L.append("side %-7s :: %s   [of=%s]" % (i, desc, of))
L.append("")
for i, disc, desc in META:
    L.append("meta %-3s :: %-10s : %s" % (i, disc, desc))
L.append("")
L.append("# ---- OPTIONAL refinement, discharges S12 without the ax_abgrp oracle ----")
for i, rule, goal in OBL_R:
    L.append("obl %-4s |- %s === %s :: %s   [alt-for=S12]" % (i, ser(goal[0]), ser(goal[1]), rule))
L.append("")
L.append("goal |- forall a b : vector(R), len(a) = len(b) => "
         "sum(eltsub(a,b)) = sum(a) - sum(b)      [via=F1]")
TXT = "\n".join(L) + "\n"
open("sum_eltsub.obl","w").write(TXT)
print(TXT)
```

          "def_sum_cons":0,"def_sub":0,"ax_abgrp":0,"assume":0,
          "sym":1,"sum_cong":1,"add_cong":2,"sub_cong":2,"trans":2,"induct":2}

OBL = []          # (id, rule, goal, premises)
def obl(i, rule, l, r, frm=()): OBL.append((i, rule, E(l, r), list(frm)))

# ---------------- L1 : BASE CASE  sum(eltsub(nil,nil)) = sum(nil) - sum(nil) --
obl("B1","def_elem_nil",  Elem(nil,nil),      nil)
obl("B2","sum_cong",      Sum(Elem(nil,nil)), Sum(nil),                      ["B1"])
obl("B3","def_sum_nil",   Sum(nil),           zero)
obl("B4","trans",         Sum(Elem(nil,nil)), zero,                          ["B2","B3"])
obl("B5","def_sum_nil",   Sum(nil),           zero)
obl("B6","def_sum_nil",   Sum(nil),           zero)
obl("B7","sub_cong",      Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)), Sub(zero,zero),            ["B5","B6"])
obl("B8","ax_abgrp",      zero,               Sub(zero,zero))
obl("B9","sym",           Sub(zero,zero),     Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)),        ["B7"])
obl("B10","trans",        zero,               Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)),        ["B8","B9"])
obl("B11","trans",        Sum(Elem(nil,nil)), Sub(Sum(nil),Sum(nil)),        ["B4","B10"])

# ---------------- L2 : LHS REDUCTION, step case ------------------------------
obl("S1","def_elem_cons", CONS_L,             CONS_R,                        [])
obl("S2","sum_cong",      SUMCL,              SUMCR,                         ["S1"])
obl("S3","def_sum_cons",  SUMCR,              Add(Sub(x,y), Sum(Elem(xs,ys))))
obl("S4","trans",         SUMCL,              Add(Sub(x,y), Sum(Elem(xs,ys))),["S2","S3"])
obl("S5","refl",          Sub(x,y),           Sub(x,y))
obl("S6","assume",        IH[0],              IH[1])                          # hypothesis

# ---------------- L3 : USE THE INDUCTION HYPOTHESIS --------------------------
obl("S7","add_cong",      Add(Sub(x,y), Sum(Elem(xs,ys))),
                          Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs, SUM_ys)),                 ["S5","S6"])
obl("S8","trans",         SUMCL,              Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),["S4","S7"])

# ---------------- L4 : RHS REDUCTION ----------------------------------------
obl("S9","def_sum_cons",  Sum(Cons(x,xs)),    Add(x, SUM_xs))
obl("S10","def_sum_cons", Sum(Cons(y,ys)),    Add(y, SUM_ys))
obl("S11","sub_cong",     Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),
                          Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)),                  ["S9","S10"])

# ---------------- L5 : THE ALGEBRAIC LEAF -----------------------------------
obl("S12","ax_abgrp",     Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),
                          Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)))
obl("S13","sym",          Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)),
                          Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),              ["S11"])
obl("S14","trans",        Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),
                          Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),              ["S12","S13"])
obl("S15","trans",        SUMCL, Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),       ["S8","S14"])

# ---------------- L6 : INDUCTION DISCHARGE ----------------------------------
obl("F1","induct",        SUMCL, Sub(Sum(Cons(x,xs)), Sum(Cons(y,ys))),       ["B11","S15"])

# ============================== SIDE CONDITIONS ==============================
SIDE = []
def side(i, desc, of): SIDE.append((i, desc, of))

for (i, rule, goal, frm) in OBL:
    if rule == "trans":
        p, q = dict((o[0],o) for o in OBL)[frm[0]], dict((o[0],o) for o in OBL)[frm[1]]
        side("sc_"+i, "middle term must match: %s == %s" % (ser(p[2][1]), ser(q[2][0])), i)
    elif rule == "ax_abgrp":
        side("sc_"+i, "normal forms must coincide (free abelian group, atoms = x,y,sum) ", i)
    elif rule == "refl":
        side("sc_"+i, "both sides must be the identical term", i)
    elif rule == "assume":
        side("sc_"+i, "context gains exactly: %s === %s" % (ser(goal[0]), ser(goal[1])), i)
    elif rule in ("def_elem_nil","def_elem_cons","def_sum_nil","def_sum_cons","def_sub"):
        side("sc_"+i, "goal must be the instance of `%s` named by its parameters" % rule, i)
    elif rule in ("sum_cong","add_cong","sub_cong","sym"):
        side("sc_"+i, "goal must be the constructor-wise lift of the premise", i)
    elif rule == "induct":
        side("sc_"+i+"a", "premise B11 must carry empty context", i)
        side("sc_"+i+"b", "premise S15 context must be EXACTLY { IH }", i)
        side("sc_"+i+"c", "base shape = (eltsub nil nil) / (sum nil - sum nil)", i)
        side("sc_"+i+"d", "step shape = (eltsub cons cons) / (sum cons - sum cons)", i)

# ============================== META OBLIGATIONS =============================
META = [
 ("M1","typing","`eltsub` is defined only on pairs in the SAME vector(R); totality on equal lengths is a typing fact, not a kernel goal"),
 ("M2","typing","`cons` preserves the carrier: R x vector(R) -> vector(R), so shared length is preserved"),
 ("M3","typing","the goal's premise `len(a) = len(b)` is absorbed by both a,b : vector(R) of the same n"),
 ("M4","modeling","rows lacking a real in either column are excluded when n is chosen; not a kernel goal"),
 ("M5","alternative","FOR UNTYPED LISTS the length premise is NOT absorbed; add goals: len(eltsub(a,b)) = len(a); len(cons(x,xs)) = 1 + len(xs); len(nil) = 0"),
]

# ============================== OPTIONAL REFINEMENT ==========================
# Eliminates the ax_abgrp oracle for S12 by spending def_sub + the four group axioms.
# R2 is the only non-trivial member: -(u+v) = (-u) + (-v).
U, V = Var("u"), Var("v")
OBL_R = [
 ("R1","def_sub",
   E(Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys)),
     Add(Add(x,SUM_xs), Sub(zero, Add(y,SUM_ys))))),
 ("R2","ax_abgrp",                                  # the neg-distributivity lemma, as one goal
   E(Sub(zero, Add(y,SUM_ys)), Add(Sub(zero,y), Sub(zero,SUM_ys)))),
 ("R3","def_sub", E(Sub(x,y), Add(x, Sub(zero,y)))),
 ("R4","def_sub", E(Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys), Add(SUM_xs, Sub(zero,SUM_ys)))),
 ("R5","ax_abgrp",
   E(Add(Add(x,Sub(zero,y)), Add(SUM_xs,Sub(zero,SUM_ys))),
     Add(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(Sub(zero,y), Sub(zero,SUM_ys))))),
 ("R6","trans", E(Add(Sub(x,y), Sub(SUM_xs,SUM_ys)),
                  Sub(Add(x,SUM_xs), Add(y,SUM_ys))))        # == goal of S12
]

# ============================== CONTEXT DISCIPLINE ===========================
IH_S = "%s === %s" % (ser(IH[0]), ser(IH[1]))
CTX = {}; DISCH = {}; order = {}
for i, rule, goal, frm in OBL:
    u = set().union(*[CTX[f] for f in frm]) if frm else set()
    d = {IH_S} if rule == "induct" else set()
    CTX[i] = u - d; DISCH[i] = d; order[i] = rule

# ============================== EMIT THE FILE ================================
L = ["muk/obligations@0.1",
     "# declaration: sum_of_elementwise_differences",
     "# syntax: obl <id> |- <lhs> === <rhs> :: <rule> from=[...] ctx=[...]",
     "# NOTHING HERE IS DISCHARGED. This file states WHAT must be proved.",
     ""]
for i, rule, goal, frm in OBL:
    L.append("obl %-4s |- %s === %s\n        :: %s from=[%s] ctx=[%s]"
             % (i, ser(goal[0]), ser(goal[1]), rule, ",".join(frm),
                ",".join(sorted(CTX[i])))) 
L.append("")
for i, desc, of in SIDE:
    L.append("side %-7s :: %s   [of=%s]" % (i, desc, of))
L.append("")
for i, disc, desc in META:
    L.append("meta %-3s :: %-10s : %s" % (i, disc, desc))
L.append("")
L.append("# ---- OPTIONAL refinement, discharges S12 without the ax_abgrp oracle ----")
for i, rule, goal in OBL_R:
    L.append("obl %-4s |- %s === %s :: %s   [alt-for=S12]" % (i, ser(goal[0]), ser(goal[1]), rule))
L.append("")
L.append("goal |- forall a b : vector(R), len(a) = len(b) => "
         "sum(eltsub(a,b)) = sum(a) - sum(b)      [via=F1]")
TXT = "\n".join(L) + "\n"
open("sum_eltsub.obl","w").write(TXT)
print(TXT)
